column3: “Let them go around” is rendered “observe … on schedule”; NASB adds “once.”
NASB supplies “a city of.”
“Like the circle” is rendered “encircling you,” and “fortifications” as “battle towers.”
“Like a necromancer” is rendered “like that of a spirit,” and NASB adds “where you are prostrate.”
“Strangers” is rendered “enemies.”
“Visited” is rendered “punished.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Delay” is rendered “Be delayed and wait.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“One who knows writing” is rendered “the one who is literate.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“With mouth” is rendered “with their words,” and “a command of men learned” as “tradition learned by rote.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Who make deep … to hide” is rendered “who deeply hide.”
“Your perversity!” is rendered “You turn things around!” and the comparison is reversed (“the potter … as equal with the clay”).
“Orchard” is rendered “fertile field.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Humble” is rendered “afflicted,” and “add joy” as “increase their gladness.”
“Lie in wait for wickedness” is rendered “are intent on doing evil.”
“Cause a person to sin with a word” is rendered “cause a person to be indicted by a word,” and “emptiness” as “meaningless arguments.”
NASB moves “concerning the house of Jacob” after the clause about Abraham.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Understanding” is rendered “the truth,” and “murmurers” as “those who criticize.”
